newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Goudsmit hits new highs on takeover plan.
newsitem.headline: Goudsmit hits new highs on takeover plan.

text.p: Shares in temporary employment services group Goudsmit hit new highs on Tuesday following news late on Monday of a planned takeover which would make it one of the biggest players in the sector in the Netherlands.

Goudsmit shares were up 41.60 guilders or 15.5 percent at 310.50 after the company said it planned to take over privately owned Unique International. The move would create a group with combined annual sales of some 600 million guilders.
Dealers said this would lift Goudsmit into the big league with the likes of Randstad and Vedior and that the shares could therefore attract a higher multiple.

"Randstad and Vedior trade at price-earnings multiples of 30 and more, so if you assume earnings per share of 13 to 15 guilders for Goudsmit this year then the shares could reach a level of 400 guilders," said one dealer.
By midsession some 40,000 Goudsmit shares had changed hands on the Amsterdam bourse, compared with average daily turnover of some 16,000.
Goudsmit shares are due to undergo a five-for-one share split at the end of this month.
